summary: Implemented the Lambda (vanilla) and Lambdad (dictionary) transforms with LambdaD and LambdaDict aliases, added docs entries, and added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Changes are in monai/transforms/utility/array.py, monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py, and docs/source/transforms.rst. The git diff of the dictionary module removes only the typing import line; all other original lines are unchanged. Nothing was committed, and tests, flake8, and black were not run per instructions, so verification was by reading the code only.
